result.reason: The redline appropriately narrows the restriction to a Deerskin-branded consumer website, removes open-ended similar-product and similar-company language, limits it to the term, and adds internal-development and acquisition carve-outs. However, it does not cap the restriction at 12 months; if the agreement term exceeds 12 months, the covenant exceeds the fallback position. The margin comment does not cure this operative-language deficiency.
